description: This file defines the Map class within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. The primary functionality provided is retrieving total orders grouped by country, including order counts and sums. It interacts with the database to perform this aggregation based on order status and payment country.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Represents a model for retrieving order data grouped by country for the admin dashboard extension in OpenCart.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Returns an array with the total number of orders and total amount per country, filtered by complete order statuses.
